properties.name: Nairobi
properties.description: Capital city. Diverse urban-rural land cover including Nairobi National Park, dense built-up areas, and peri-urban agriculture.

properties.name: Nakuru
properties.description: Rift Valley city featuring Lake Nakuru (alkaline lake with flamingo habitat), surrounding agricultural land, and Menengai Crater.

properties.name: Murang'a
properties.description: Central Kenya highlands. Tea and coffee plantations, dense montane vegetation transitioning to mixed agriculture at lower elevations.

properties.name: Siaya
properties.description: Western Kenya near Lake Victoria. Flat terrain dominated by smallholder agriculture, wetlands, and scattered tree cover.

properties.name: Elgeyo-Marakwet
properties.description: Western Kenya Rift escarpment. Dramatic elevation gradient from Kerio Valley floor (900m) to Cherangani Hills (3000m+). Mixed forest, dryland, and irrigated agriculture.
